talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 5 solo PCPs winding down in Montana, several with no local backup — drive-time gap risk.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~1,189 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 3 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~14,400 patients across 12 at-risk practices statewide.
